goal: Phase 2 (generated-manual) of campaign env-independence-and-generated-docs: docs/COMMANDS.md is regenerated from the option tables the CLI dispatches on, preserving the authored prose by position and flag name, with npm run docs, npm run docs:check and a CI step. Spec: docs/campaigns/env-independence-and-generated-docs/spec/SPEC.md.

definitionOfDone.text: manual, command-surface, link-check and docs-map tests pass
npm run docs:check finds the committed manual current
the derivable parts of every section come from the exported option tables, the authored parts survive regeneration byte for byte, and CI runs the check

taskPacket.objective: src/cli/manual.mjs regenerates the derivable parts of docs/COMMANDS.md (heading set, synopsis lines, flag table rows) from COMMAND_OPTIONS and each verb module's OPERATION_OPTIONS while preserving the authored parts (description paragraphs, flag Effect and Default cells by flag name, reads/writes paragraphs, examples, related lines); running it on today's manual produces no diff, a new undocumented flag fails a test, a removed verb or flag disappears, and CI checks the file is current.
instructions: Evidence: docs/COMMANDS.md is 42,156 bytes written by hand for 20 verbs and 22 operations; test/docs/command-surface.test.mjs keeps only the heading set aligned with the code (it regex-reads `const COMMAND_OPTIONS = {` in src/cli.mjs and `const OPERATION_OPTIONS = {` in src/cli/{campaign,seat,contract,skills}.mjs). A flag added to a table today is invisible to every test.

Change 1, the tables become importable without moving them: export COMMAND_OPTIONS from src/cli.mjs and OPERATION_OPTIONS from src/cli/campaign.mjs, seat.mjs, contract.mjs and skills.mjs (keep the literal shape `const ..._OPTIONS = {` on its own line so the existing command-surface regex still matches). src/cli.mjs is 526 lines; adding `export` is all it needs.

Change 2, src/cli/manual.mjs (a program with a small exported core): `renderManual(current, surface)` takes the current manual text and the surface (verbs -> flags with types; operations per verb -> flags) and returns the regenerated text. Section order and the fixed sections (Invocation, Global flags, Exit codes, Environment) are preserved verbatim. For each verb `## faberun <verb>` and operation `### faberun <verb> <operation>`: the heading and the ```text synopsis line are regenerated from the table (positional placeholder kept from the current synopsis when present; flags rendered as `[--flag <value>]` for strings, `[--flag]` for booleans, `multiple` flags as `[--flag <a>...]`); the flag table keeps the header `| Flag | Value | Effect | Default |` and one row per declared flag in declaration order, carrying the current row's Value, Effect and Default cells when a row for that flag exists and `<value>`, empty, `—` otherwise; rows for flags no longer declared are dropped; every other line of the section (description, reads/writes, example, related) is kept as authored. A verb or operation absent from the manual gets a skeleton section; one absent from the code is removed. Running with `--write` rewrites docs/COMMANDS.md; `--check` exits 1 and prints a unified diff summary when the file would change.
Change 3, package.json scripts: `docs`: `node src/cli/manual.mjs --write`, `docs:check`: `node src/cli/manual.mjs --check`. .github/workflows/ci.yml gains `- run: npm run docs:check` after typecheck.

Change 4, first generation: run `npm run docs` and make the result byte-identical to the committed manual except for genuine drift you find (a flag missing from a table, a stale synopsis); fix the drift in the manual's authored cells, never in the code, and list what drifted in the result summary. If today's manual has a flag row the code no longer declares, that row is drift and goes.

Tests, test/cli/manual.test.mjs: 'manual regenerates today's file without a diff' (renderManual(current, surface) === current after `npm run docs` has been applied); 'manual covers every flag' (a surface with an extra flag yields a row with an empty Effect cell and the test that scans the real manual for empty Effect cells fails on it); 'manual drops removed verbs' (a surface without a verb removes its section); 'manual preserves authored blocks' (a description paragraph and an example survive regeneration). Keep test/docs/command-surface.test.mjs passing; it stays as the independent two-way check.

Docs: docs/COMMANDS.md's Invocation section (authored, preserved) gains one sentence saying the file is generated by `npm run docs` and where authored text lives. docs/ARCHITECTURE.md or docs/CONCEPTS.md: one sentence where documentation is described, if such a place exists; otherwise none.
decisions: Generate, do not verify: the manual's derivable parts come from the tables the CLI dispatches on; a parallel table would be the wrong design.
Authored prose is preserved by position and flag name, not by markers; the first regeneration must be a no-op on today's content.
No CLI verb for the generator: it is a program under src/cli run by npm scripts, so the command surface does not change.
nonGoals: No change to any verb, flag or exit code.
No change to renderUsage in src/cli/brand.mjs.
No edit to skills/faberun/references/*.md, docs/history/**, docs/campaigns/**, evals/golden/**. CONTRACT_VERSION stays 0.3.0.
No file over 800 lines: when a module or test file you must extend is near the ceiling, add a new module or test file instead of growing it.
Do not run the full suite yourself; the controller runs your verification after you declare done. Quick targeted test files are fine.
No new test bounds a measured duration from above, depends on the wall clock, on a binary in PATH, or on the machine layout: that is the theme of this campaign.
